startNow: Heat olive oil in the skillet

units.actionPlain: Cut the bell peppers into bite-sized pieces. Finely chop the onion and garlic.
units.actionInline: Cut 1 kg bell peppers into bite-sized pieces. Finely chop 1 onion and 2 garlic cloves.

units.actionPlain: Heat the oil in the skillet. Saute the bell peppers and onion. Add the garlic, ajvar and paprika powder and fry briefly.
units.actionInline: Heat 1 tbsp oil in the skillet. Saute the bell peppers and onion. Add the garlic, 3 tbsp ajvar and 2 tsp sweet paprika and fry briefly.

units.actionPlain: Add the uncooked rice and broth. Cover and simmer on medium heat, stirring occasionally and adding a little water if needed.
units.actionInline: Add 250 g uncooked rice and 500 ml vegetable broth. Cover and simmer on medium heat, stirring occasionally and adding a little water if needed.
units.critical: Simmer covered ~20 min until rice is tender

units.actionPlain: Season to taste with salt, pepper and paprika.
units.actionInline: Season to taste with salt, pepper and paprika.

startNow: Bring a high-sided pot of salted water to a boil

nowYouNeed.item: extra virgin olive oil, for frying

units.actionPlain: Wash and trim the zucchini, then thinly slice into rounds. Fry the slices in batches until golden.
units.actionInline: Wash and trim 25 oz zucchini and thinly slice into rounds. Fry in batches in oil until golden.
units.critical: Oil at 150 °C (300 °F); fry 5-6 min per batch until golden

units.actionPlain: Drain the fried zucchini on paper towels. Season with salt and scatter torn basil. Set aside.
units.actionInline: Drain the fried zucchini on paper towels, season with salt and scatter torn basil. Set aside.

units.actionPlain: Coarsely grate the Parmesan and Provolone. Cook the spaghetti in the boiling salted water until very al dente.
units.actionInline: Coarsely grate 1/4 cup Parmesan and 5.3 oz Provolone. Cook 11 oz spaghetti in the boiling salted water until very al dente.
units.critical: Cook spaghetti ~6 min, very al dente

units.actionPlain: Heat oil in a wide pan. Add the whole garlic to infuse, then remove it. Add the fried zucchini.
units.actionInline: Heat 2 1/2 tbsp oil in a wide pan. Infuse with 1 whole garlic clove, then remove it. Add the fried zucchini.

units.actionPlain: Add a ladle of pasta cooking water and saute briefly. Drain the spaghetti into the pan, saving the cooking water.
units.actionInline: Add a ladle of pasta cooking water and saute briefly. Drain the spaghetti into the pan, saving the cooking water.
units.reserve: Save the pasta cooking water for creaming.

units.actionPlain: Stir the spaghetti risotto-style, adding pasta water as needed. Off the heat, stir in part of the Provolone until creamy, then sprinkle over the Parmesan and the remaining Provolone.
units.actionInline: Stir the spaghetti risotto-style ~3 min, adding pasta water as needed. Off the heat, stir in part of the 5.3 oz Provolone until creamy, then sprinkle over 1/4 cup Parmesan and the remaining Provolone.
units.reserve: Remaining Provolone to sprinkle on top.
units.critical: Take off the heat before adding cheese so it melts creamy, not clumpy

units.actionPlain: Stir in torn basil and a final ladle of pasta water. Finish with freshly ground black pepper and serve hot.
units.actionInline: Stir in torn basil and a final ladle of pasta water. Finish with freshly ground black pepper and serve hot.

units.actionPlain: Dice the pumpkin small. Finely chop the onion and garlic. Slice the leek into rings.
units.actionInline: Dice 500 g pumpkin small. Finely chop 1 red onion and 1 garlic clove. Slice 1 leek into rings.

units.actionPlain: Heat the oil and saute the onion and garlic. Stir in the tomato paste and toast briefly. Add the broth, pumpkin and leek. Cover and simmer on medium heat.
units.actionInline: Heat 1 tbsp oil and saute the onion and garlic. Stir in 2 tbsp tomato paste and toast briefly. Add 300 ml broth, the pumpkin and leek. Cover and simmer on medium heat.

units.actionPlain: Stir in the cream cheese. Season with salt, pepper, nutmeg and curry.
units.actionInline: Stir in 200 g cream cheese. Season with salt, pepper, nutmeg and curry powder.

units.actionPlain: Spread the gnocchi in a baking dish. Cover with the pumpkin mixture and scatter the mozzarella over the top.
units.actionInline: Spread 500 g gnocchi in a baking dish. Cover with the pumpkin mixture and scatter 80 g grated mozzarella over the top.
Bake 30 min until golden and bubbling.
